# CardTuck Code of Conduct

Treat contributors and users with respect. Discuss the work, assume good faith, and give feedback people can act on. Respect different levels of experience and protect the privacy of people whose information appears on business cards.

Harassment, threats, personal attacks, discriminatory language, and sharing someone’s private information without permission are unacceptable. This applies to issues, pull requests, and other project spaces.

For a conduct concern, use [GitHub’s reporting tools](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam) or contact a repository maintainer through GitHub. Maintainers may remove content or restrict participation to protect the community.
